pages.text: Most metal is forged hot. Put ingots in a $(item)blast furnace$() (or furnace) to get $(item)heated ingots$(). A heated ingot cools back down after a while, and dropped in water it cools at once.
Hot metal burns the hand that holds it. Hold $(item)tongs$() in the other hand to carry it safely: wooden tongs are made from sticks, iron and steel ones are forged as two halves and joined.
